snapshot.title: FBI Field Agent Arrival — Orchard Standpipe Site Secured

fields.narration: This is FBI Agent Elena Torres, Field Supervisor, Cyber-Physical Division. We’ve arrived at the Orchard Standpipe site. We’ve secured the site and are now in control of the evidence chain. We’ve pulled the full RTU-02 event log and MBW-NVR-01 video stream for 02:00–05:00. We’ve confirmed that no remote session on MBW-JUMP-01 or MBW-FW-01 matches any approved Kessler Controls window (WO-24-1187). The only physical access was via the ladder cage and gate. We are now performing a forensic analysis on the MBW-NVR-01 storage drive. The control system is not compromised. We will provide a status update in 90 minutes.
worldState: The FBI has assumed on-site control of the Orchard Standpipe facility and the evidence chain.
All video and RTU-02 event logs are under FBI custody.
The FBI has confirmed no remote access via MBW-JUMP-01 or MBW-FW-01 matches the approved Kessler Controls window (WO-24-1187).
The control system remains un-compromised per FBI preliminary assessment.
The FBI will issue a full forensic status update in 90 minutes.
fields.facilitatorNote: Confirm that the Incident Commander has accepted FBI authority over the site and evidence. Ensure the SCADA / IT Security Manager is instructed to provide full access to RTU-02 logs and MBW-NVR-01 video under Form SEC-4.
